questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q:
Consider $\int x \tan ^{-1} x d x=\mathrm{A}\left(x^2+1\right) \tan ^{-1} x+\mathrm{B} x+\mathrm{C}$, where C is the constant of integration.
What is the value of A ?
questions.solution:
$\begin{aligned} & \int x \cdot \tan ^{-1} x d x=\mathrm{A}\left(x^2+1\right) \tan ^{-1} x+\mathrm{B} x+\mathrm{C} \\ & \text {Let } \mathrm{I}=\int x \cdot \tan ^{-1} x d x \\ &=\tan ^{-1} x \cdot\left(\frac{x^2}{2}\right)-\int \frac{1}{1+x^2} \cdot \frac{x^2}{2} d x \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{x^2}{1+x^2} d x \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{\left(1+x^2\right)-1}{1+x^2} d x \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2}\left[\int 1 d x-\int \frac{1}{1+x^2} d x\right] \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2}\left[x-\tan ^{-1} x\right]+\mathrm{C} \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2} x+\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x+\mathrm{C} \\ &=\left(\frac{x^2+1}{2}\right) \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{x}{2}+\mathrm{C}\end{aligned}$
Value of $\mathrm{A}=\frac{1}{2}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q:
Consider $\int x \tan ^{-1} x d x=\mathrm{A}\left(x^2+1\right) \tan ^{-1} x+\mathrm{B} x+\mathrm{C}$, where C is the constant of integration.
What is the value of B?
questions.solution:
$\begin{aligned} & \int x \cdot \tan ^{-1} x d x=\mathrm{A}\left(x^2+1\right) \tan ^{-1} x+\mathrm{B} x+\mathrm{C} \\ & \text {Let } \mathrm{I}=\int x \cdot \tan ^{-1} x d x \\ &=\tan ^{-1} x \cdot\left(\frac{x^2}{2}\right)-\int \frac{1}{1+x^2} \cdot \frac{x^2}{2} d x \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{x^2}{1+x^2} d x \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{\left(1+x^2\right)-1}{1+x^2} d x \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2}\left[\int 1 d x-\int \frac{1}{1+x^2} d x\right] \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2}\left[x-\tan ^{-1} x\right]+\mathrm{C} \\ &=\frac{x^2}{2} \cdot \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{1}{2} x+\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x+\mathrm{C} \\ &=\left(\frac{x^2+1}{2}\right) \tan ^{-1} x-\frac{x}{2}+\mathrm{C}\end{aligned}$
Value of $\mathrm{B}=-\frac{1}{2}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: What is $\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}$ equal to?
questions.solution:
Let $\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}=x\Rightarrow \quad \sin x=\frac{3}{5} \qquad \therefore \cos x=\frac{4}{5}$
and $\quad \sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}=y\Rightarrow \quad \sin y=\frac{4}{5} \qquad \therefore \cos y=\frac{3}{5}\begin{aligned} \sin (x+y) & =\sin x \cdot \cos y+\cos x \cdot \sin y \\ & =\frac{3}{5} \times \frac{3}{5}+\frac{4}{5} \times \frac{4}{5}=\frac{9}{25}+\frac{16}{25}=\frac{25}{25}=1 \\ \therefore \quad \sin (x+y) & =\sin \frac{\pi}{2} \\ \Rightarrow \quad x+y & =\frac{\pi}{2} \\ \Rightarrow & \sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\sin ^{-1} \frac{4}{5}=\frac{\pi}{2} .\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The probability that in a random arrangement of the letters of the word 'UNIVERSITY' the two I's do not come together is
questions.solution:
The total number of arrangements of the letters of the word 'UNIVERSITY' is $\frac{10!}{2!}$ as there are two I's.
Regarding 2I's as one letter, number of ways of arrangement in which both I's are together $=9$ !
So, the number of ways in which 2 I's are not together
$=\frac{10!}{2!}-9!$
Hence, the required probability
$=\frac{\frac{10!}{2!}-9!}{\frac{10!}{2!}}=1-\frac{2!9!}{10!}=\frac{4}{5}$.

questions.q: If $\cot \mathrm{A}=2$ and $\cot \mathrm{B}=3$, then what is the value of $A+B$ ?
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \cot A=2 \therefore \tan A=\frac{1}{2} \\ & \text {and } \cot B=3 \therefore \tan B=\frac{1}{3} \\ & \tan (A+B)=\frac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A \cdot \tan B}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{3}}{1-\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{3}} \\ & \Rightarrow \tan (A+B)=\frac{5}{6} \times \frac{6}{5}=1 \\ & \Rightarrow \tan (A+B)=\tan \frac{\pi}{4} \\ & \Rightarrow \quad A+B=\frac{\pi}{4}\end{aligned}$

questions.q: What is $\frac{\cos 7 x-\cos 3 x}{\sin 7 x-2 \sin 5 x+\sin 3 x}$ equal to?
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \frac{\cos 7 x-\cos 3 x}{\sin 7 x+\sin 3 x-2 \sin 5 x} \\ & =\frac{-2 \sin 5 x \cdot \sin 2 x}{2 \sin 5 x \cdot \cos 2 x-2 \sin 5 x} \\ & =\frac{-2 \sin 5 x \cdot \sin 2 x}{-2 \sin 5 x(1-\cos 2 x)}=\frac{\sin 2 x}{2 \sin ^2 x} \\ & =\frac{2 \sin x \cdot \cos x}{2 \sin x \cdot \sin x}=\cot x .\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\frac{\sin (x+y)}{\sin (x-y)}=\frac{a+b}{a-b}$, then what is $\frac{\tan x}{\tan y}$ equal to?
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \frac{\sin (x+y)+\sin (x-y)}{\sin (x+y)-\sin (x-y)}=\frac{a+b+a-b}{a+b-a+b} \\ & \frac{2 \sin \left(\frac{x+y+x-y}{2}\right) \cdot \cos \left(\frac{x+y-x+y}{2}\right)}{2 \cos \left(\frac{x+y+x-y}{2}\right) \cdot \sin \left(\frac{x+y-x+y}{2}\right)}=\frac{2 a}{2 b} \\ & \Rightarrow \quad \frac{\sin x \cdot \cos y}{\cos x \cdot \sin y}=\frac{a}{b} \\ & \Rightarrow \quad \tan x \times \cot y=\frac{a}{b} \\ & \Rightarrow \quad \tan x \times \frac{1}{\tan y}=\frac{a}{b} \quad \Rightarrow \frac{\tan x}{\tan y}=\frac{a}{b}\end{aligned}$

questions.q: In a triangle $A B C, \sin A-\cos B=\cos C$, then what is $B$ euqal to?
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \because \quad \sin A-\cos B=\cos C \text { (given) } \\ & \Rightarrow \quad \cos B+\cos C=\sin A \\ & \Rightarrow \quad 2 \cos \frac{B+C}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{B-C}{2}=\sin A \\ & \Rightarrow \quad 2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{(B-C)}{2}=2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{A}{2}\end{aligned}\Rightarrow \quad \cos \frac{(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C})}{2}=\cos \frac{\mathrm{A}}{2}\Rightarrow \quad \frac{\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C}}{2}=\frac{\mathrm{A}}{2}\Rightarrow \quad \mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C}=\mathrm{A}\Rightarrow \quad B=A+C\because \quad A+B+C=180^{\circ}\Rightarrow \quad B+B=180^{\circ}\Rightarrow \quad 2 \mathrm{~B}=180^{\circ}\Rightarrow \quad \mathrm{B}=90^{\circ}=\frac{\pi}{2}$
